scenes.contextualRelevance: The fast-paced editing and jump cuts contribute to a sense of urgency and excitement surrounding AI. The use of question marks and a reassuring tone speaks to the common anxieties many people experience when confronted with new technology.

narrativeProgression.description: The woman introduces the topic of AI and its growing presence in the business world, highlighting the confusion and unfamiliarity many people have with it.
Acknowledgment of the challenges in getting started with AI.
Reassurance and promise of a simple solution.
